extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, created using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website. The dataset enables accurate and scalable Arabic OCR training and evaluation.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset arabic-img2md was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. The dataset contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. Additionally, a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens was extracted from over 8,500 books using the SOTA model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, which was then converted to PDFs and processed to extract Markdown text representations of Arabic book pages
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: HTML scraping from Hindawi website, conversion to PDFs, and Markdown extraction
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset enables accurate and scalable Arabic OCR training and evaluation. The large-scale dataset provides a valuable resource for downstream NLP tasks and further Arabic OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
